description: A creator's observed profile by handle (uniqueId). A creator not stored yet (or whose TikTok read is failing) returns {"status":"resolving","retryAfterSeconds":N} instead of a profile: that is "not ready yet", not an error and not billed — call this tool again with the same uid after retryAfterSeconds (up to 120), and stop after about 3 minutes.
name: creators_get
